tara: Quick sync — gating operator sprint idea. Need a lightweight admin flow to pause noisy playbook runs and surface an owner stewardship backlog. Seeing duplicate-claim races when reassigns happen. @kevin can you triage?
kevin: Yep, I can take a look. Do we have a reproducible query to find accounts with conflicting owner assignments? :eyes:
junaid: I have something locally, but would prefer to run against staging first.
tara: Quick SQL I used in sandbox: ```sql
SELECT account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT owner_id) AS owners, max(updated_at) as last_change
FROM owner_claims
WHERE updated_at > now() - interval '7 days'
GROUP BY account_id
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT owner_id) > 1;
```
Let's run that against staging to get a signal set.
sophia: FYI healthscore pipeline retries are creating phantom claims that show as churn. We should gate playbook triggers when healthscore state == 'pending_sync' to avoid noisy churn.
kevin: Good catch. So two pieces: (1) prevent triggers when pending_sync, (2) add a short-term admin "quarantine" state so playbooks skip those accounts during churn windows.
junaid: I can add a claim_version check in the runner so actions only proceed if claim_version == latest_claim_version. Also propose a small admin endpoint to mark an account quarantined: POST /admin/quarantine {account_id, reason, ttl_days}.
csops-bot: run-queue: dry-run complete — 23 accounts flagged for quarantine (staging). Report: https://redwood.internal/reports/ops/1749981111/dryrun
kevin: That dry-run looks safe. Schedule a deploy to staging tomorrow 09:30 PT for the runner guard + quarantine endpoint. Tara to own comms to Enablement/CS about expected behavior.
tara: I will draft the enablement note. Also we need retention of quarantine history for audit — keep records for 30 days at minimum. @sophia can legal sign off on retention?
sophia: Legal ok with 30 days, add an audit_event row with actor, timestamp, and reason. :+1:
junaid: PR plan: add claim_version guard in playbook-runner, add /admin/quarantine + background sweeper that lifts quarantine after TTL. I'll put up a PR today EOD; QA tomorrow.
tara: Follow-ups for sprint board: 1) dry-run on prod-like dataset 2) feature flag `quarantine_on_owner_churn` default OFF 3) alert if quarantines > 50/day to avoid mass false-positives. I'll create tickets and tag owners. Thanks all! :rocket:
csops-bot: incident-bot: created run ID 78621 for this gating experiment.
kevin: Leaving notes in the ticket about rate limits and backpressure — runner should backoff instead of retry-flooding.
junaid: Noted, will include exponential backoff. ETA for full rollout to prod: next week pending QA signoff.
tara: Perfect. I'll sync with Enablement to prepare a one-pager and short training for CS agents so they know what "quarantine" means in the UI. Closing the thread for now, will post updates here.
